definitions.explanation: The property or treatment of repelling water, causing it to bead up and roll off a surface rather than soaking in. Commonly used to describe fabric treatments and coatings.

examples.japanese: {撥水|はっすい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{撥水|はっすい}{性|せい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。
examples.english: This fabric has excellent water repellency.

examples.japanese: {撥水|はっすい}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{吹|ふ}きかけておけば、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧だ。
examples.english: If you spray water-repellent on your shoes, you can feel at ease even on rainy days.

notes:
Compound noun: {撥|はつ} (to repel) + {水|すい} (water). Often used as a modifier in compound forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {撥水|はっすい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧ (water-repellent treatment/finish)
- {撥水|はっすい}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧ (water-repellent spray)
- {撥水|はっすい}{性|せい} (water repellency)
- {撥水|はっすい}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (water-repellent effect)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧: waterproof — completely prevents water penetration
- {撥水|はっすい}: water-repellent — causes water to bead and roll off, but not fully waterproof
